subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

Only two people sit between F and C, when counted from the right of F. Only two people sit between C and A, when counted from the right of C. Only three people sit between F and G, when counted from the right of F. E sits to the immediate left of D.

How many people sit between D and F, when counted from the right of D?
solution:
**Given:**

A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1. Only two people sit between F and C, when counted from the right of F.

2. Only two people sit between C and A, when counted from the right of C.

3. Only three people sit between F and G, when counted from the right of F.

4. E sits to the immediate left
